answer.answer: Among Texas ownership types with at least 5 hospitals, ordered by average “would definitely recommend” percentage: Government - Local — 11 hospitals, 79.0% recommend, 3.0 average stars; Government - State — 15, 79.0%, 3.67 stars; Physician — 27, 78.85%, 3.67 stars; Government - Hospital District or Authority — 78, 75.73%, 2.77 stars; Voluntary non-profit - Other — 18, 74.36%, 3.43 stars; Veterans Health Administration — 5, 74.2%, 4.4 stars; Voluntary non-profit - Private — 134, 73.52%, 3.7 stars; Voluntary non-profit - Church — 5, 73.5%, 3.75 stars; Proprietary — 171, 68.58%, 3.01 stars. Hospital counts include hospitals without a recommend score.
answer.sql: SELECT h.hospital_ownership AS ownership_type, COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) AS hospital_count, ROUND(CAST(AVG(hc.top_box_pct) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(CAST(h.overall_rating AS DECIMAL)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_overall_star_rating FROM hq.hospitals AS h LEFT JOIN hq.v_hcahps AS hc ON hc.facility_id = h.facility_id AND hc.measure_id = 'H_RECMND_DY' WHERE h.is_texas = TRUE AND h.hospital_ownership IS NOT NULL GROUP BY h.hospital_ownership HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.facility_id) >= 5 ORDER BY avg_would_definitely_recommend_pct DESC NULLS LAST, ownership_type LIMIT 200
